item.title: Kumano Hayatama Taisha: The Vermilion Shrine of Shingu — Guide
item.description: Kumano Hayatama Taisha stands in the river town of Shingu near the mouth of the Kumano River, the third of the three grand shrines of Kumano and the most vividly coloured: its halls glow in brilliant vermilion, a striking contrast to the unpainted austerity of Hongu. In its grounds grows a sacred nagi tree said to be around 1,000 years old, Japan’s largest, whose leaves pilgrims once carried as talismans for safe travel.
